title: Settlement of the Dues Standing on a Northbeam Circle Membership
content:
## The request this schedule answers

A member who asks to put the dues on a Northbeam Circle Membership back into good standing is dealt with
under this schedule. What it governs is one figure: the money the member pays now against the dues
standing on that membership, and the payment entry that money is booked as.

## What the booking does to the record

The money is booked against the billing period it is applied to. The membership ledger gains a payment
entry carrying the money, the way it was paid and the period it was applied to; the dues still owed on the
membership drop by that money; and a membership whose dues had fallen overdue reads as active again, with
the day it fell into grace cleared. The member sees the payment on the membership straight away and the
dues owed fall accordingly.

## Whose tool this is and how it is invoked

`settle_membership_dues_c8b60f0e` is the member's own tool. The desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the
customer themselves runs it to make the payment; the desk does not make the payment for them.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| membership_id | The reference number of the Circle membership the payment is made against | An identifier, read from the membership record returned when the membership is looked up |
| settlement_payment_usd | The money the member is paying now | USD to 2 decimal places, a positive amount rounded half to even at the cent, stored at exactly that precision, with no unit symbol passed |
| payment_method | How the member is paying | Exactly one of the values below |
| applied_period_start | The first day of the billing period the payment is applied to | A calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, with no time part and no time zone |

The complete set of values `payment_method` takes: `card_on_file`, the payment card already kept on the
profile is charged; `store_credit`, the money is taken from store credit held on a Northbeam credit
account; `bank_transfer`, the member sends the money from a bank account; `in_store_cash`, the member pays
at a store counter; `business_invoice`, the amount is put on a business account's invoice to be settled on
its terms.

## What comes back

A confirmation line naming the membership, the money received, the payment method used, the billing period
the money was applied to and the reference number of the new payment entry. The presence of that payment
entry reference is what marks the call as completed.
